1251-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1251-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

4613-4687-5711.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Fanatic of Rhonas has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4687-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.

1339-1832-5231-6794.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-5231-6794.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

971-4213-4687.notablePrerequisites: Pentad Prism has at least four counters on it.
971-4213-4687.description:
Activate Hankyu by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Pentad Prism, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1479-2841-4288-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-4288-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-1580-2060-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
728-1580-2060-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-3384-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
728-3384-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1170-2146-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

4399-4518-6626-7818.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7704-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doc Samson
Repeat.

215-3443-4742.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4742.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4742.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

5137-6287-7704.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Morphling and Doc Samson are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
5137-6287-7704.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Doc Samson.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

1849-2105-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Grub trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on Combat Celebrant and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of it.
Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

889-1618-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Deekah
889-1618-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Deekah triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
889-1618-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Deekah. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

950-1849-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Fatestitcher.
Activate one of the Fatestitcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Fatestitcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

57-3094-4785-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-4785-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1636-2438-4023-6987.notablePrerequisites: Need to have a total of 5 artifact creatures
1636-2438-4023-6987.description:
Cast Robobrain War Mind by paying {3}{U}.
When Robobrain War Mind enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Robobrain War Mind trigger, causing you to get {E} for each artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Robobrain War Mind.
Activate Dr. Madison Li by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Robobrain War Mind from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5414-5531-6621-6664.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
5414-5531-6621-6664.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.

474-4050-4394-4452.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {1}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

5670-6097-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6097-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1479-4288-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4288-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1479-3478-5671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-5671.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2660-2707-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Time Walk is put on the bottom of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Time Walk from the bottom of your library during your draw step due to River Song.
Repeat.

1743-2060-3750-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five Merfolk.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1743-2060-3750-4613.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Hakbal of the Surging Soul's first ability triggers, causing you to reveal the top card of your library, put a +1/+1 counter on each Merfolk you control and putting the card back on top of your library.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Merfolk you control using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from each of them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Merfolk, this combo nets infinite colored mana and +1/+1 counters on Merfolk you control.

703-2506-4772.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating four token copies of Doubling Season that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a total of 32 Astral Dragon tokens with haste.
When the Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating an extremely large number of Doubling Season tokens that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1409-2208-3809.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Charming Scoundrel.
1409-2208-3809.description:
Activate Charming Scoundrel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Charming Scoundrel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Charming Scoundrel.
Resolve the Charming Scoundrel trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

380-643-2743-3657.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3430-4289-4824.notablePrerequisites: Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
3430-4289-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

687-1628-2034-2086.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks dies, triggering its persist ability and Necrosynthesis.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Necrosynthesis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Tayam, and both counters from Kitchen Finks.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-5 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 6, causing you to mill three cards and returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
